Read by the suite (tests/rbv.spec.ts) and by the platform (the cases Run tests lists for DECATHLON SPORTS INDIA). `writes` marks a case that changes data on UAT: it only runs when DECATH_ALLOW_WRITES=1. `users` are the user ids the case names. `tester` is Aanya's own result from the sheet, shown beside the automated one; `was` is the id before the renumbering.
_logins: The users decath/.env has a login for (role → user id). A case naming any other user is shown 'Needs a login' and runs as Not tested.
